Role & request permissions

Non-interactive reference. Try switching "Signed in as" on screen 1 to see these outcomes live.

RequestHRManagerTeam memberSatisfies
View employee profileAllowed — full profile shownAllowed — full profile shownRejected — profile never shownAC1, AC2
Update employee profileAllowed — profile savedAllowed — profile savedRejected — profile unchangedAC3, AC4

A rejected request never renders profile data and never saves a change — the rejection happens at the point the request is made, same as the underlying API returning a 403.

Employee ID lock

Jordan Reyes's employeeId (emp_2031) was set when onboarding completed. Here's what happens if an update submission tries to change it anyway.

Submitted update

⚠ Includes a different ID
employeeIdemp_9999 (attempted)
roleSenior Software Engineer
employmentStatusActive

Saved profile

🔒 ID unchanged
employeeIdemp_2031 (unchanged)
roleSenior Software Engineer (updated)
employmentStatusActive (unchanged)

Every other submitted field — role, in this example — still saves normally. Only employeeId is ever rejected and held at its original value.

Acceptance criteria checklist

Every acceptance criterion for this story, mapped to where it's demonstrated.

1

HR/Manager sees all six fields — AC1

As HR or Manager, selecting an employee from "Viewing" renders name, email, department, role, start date, and employment status.

2

Non-HR/Manager view is rejected — AC2

As Team member, selecting any employee shows a permission-denied panel instead of the profile — the fields never render.

3

HR/Manager update saves the new values — AC3

"Edit profile" opens a form pre-filled with current values; changing any of the six fields and saving updates the profile in place.

4

Non-HR/Manager update is rejected — AC4

As Team member, "Edit profile" shows the same permission-denied notice and the profile's values never change.

5

employeeId stays unchanged once set — AC5

The edit form's Employee ID field is read-only and locked; see "Employee ID lock" for the before/after when a different ID is submitted anyway.
